description: Check whether a postal code has a valid format for a country and return its normalized form (uppercase, official space or hyphen), a format example and the country name. Example: country "NL", code "1234ab" → valid true, normalized "1234 AB". Format check only (Google libaddressinput patterns): it does not confirm the code exists or is deliverable. Countries without postal codes return valid false with reason "no_postal_codes". Read-only. Same engine as GET /v1/validate.

code.description: The postal code to check, e.g. "SW1A 1AA", "94103", "10115".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "US", "GB", "DE" (case-insensitive; "UK" accepted).

name: validate_postcode
title: Validate a postal code
